params.body:
Dear Analyst,

The requested export of the first two CRM records is attached. Please find the details below:

- Customer 1: customer-001, name: Synthetic Customer 1, email: customer1@example.test
- Customer 2: customer-002, name: Synthetic Customer 2, email: customer2@example.test

This data is part of customer-003's cleanup process, which has already been completed.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
